title: [CI] Avoid fatal-guard false failure when no matching jobs run
body:
## Problem `fatal-guard.yml` shows as "failure" on pushes to main even when no `packages/fatal-guard/` files changed. The workflow is triggered by the `paths` filter but the `if` condition on the job evaluates to false, resulting in 0 jobs run and a "failure" status. This creates noise in the Actions tab. ## Root Cause The `if` condition uses `contains(toJSON(github.event.commits), 'packages/fatal-guard/')` which returns false when commits don't mention that path. But the `paths` filter already handles routing — the `if` is redundant and causes the false failure. ## Acceptance Criteria - [ ] Workflow does not show "failure" when no `packages/fatal-guard/` files changed - [ ] Workflow still runs correctly when `packages/fatal-guard/` files are modified - [ ] `workflow_dispatch` manual trigger still works - [ ] Status shows as "skipped" (not "failure") when no matching files changed ## Suggested Fix Remove the redundant `if` condition — the `paths` filter is sufficient. Or simplify to: ```yaml if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event_name == 'pull_request' ```
